name: toolcrib
description: Per-category slice of component-manifest.json's "components" array (category: Form Controls), for on-demand detail without loading the full manifest. See component-manifest.json for themeSystem/zIndexScale/eventBus and cross-category data.

components.name: Button

variant.description:
Visual style variant.
- `'primary'` — Filled with primary colour.
- `'secondary'` — Filled with secondary colour.
- `'outline'` — Transparent with border.
- `'danger'` — Filled with error colour.
- `'ghost'` — No background or border.

size.description: Button size controlling padding and font-size.

paddingMode.description: Override padding using the theme padding token scale.

cornerRadiusMode.description: Override corner radius using the theme radius token scale.

leadingIcon.description: Icon rendered before the label text. Alias for `icon`.

trailingIcon.description: Icon rendered after the label text.

subtheme.description: Apply a subtheme colour. Falls back to the nearest `<StyleDomainProvider>`'s if omitted.

squareCorners.description:
Explicit corner-squaring override, e.g. for a trigger button whose
corner needs to flatten against an open `<Popup>`/`<DropdownMenu>`.
Applied after the button's own computed radius, so it wins.

overrides.description:
Per-instance overrides for label weight and icon spacing. Separate from
`subtheme` above (Button already resolves that itself via
`useResolvedSubtheme`, unrelated to this slice's own two fields).

components.description: Styled button with five variants, three sizes, subtheme colouring, and icon slots

components.name: Calendar

name.description: Field name included in emitted `calendar:changed` events.

value.description:
Controlled selected date, as an `@internationalized/date` `CalendarDate`
-- never a raw JS `Date` at this boundary. Convert to/from a plain
`Date` at your own call site if your backend needs one.

onChange.description: Change handler. Receives the newly selected date.

isDisabled.description: If true, the whole calendar is non-interactive.

locale.description:
BCP 47 locale tag controlling month/day names, week start day, and
date-grid layout. Fixed, not browser-auto-detected -- see
`<TimeField>`'s own doc for why an explicit default (not just a
provider's presence) is what actually prevents an SSR hydration
mismatch.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for grid cell size. `overrides.cellSize` wins over `size` below if both are set.

size.description: Control size, standardized with `<Button>` and every other sized control — maps onto the same scale as `overrides.cellSize` and scales the month heading's font size.

components.description: Month grid for selecting a single date, built on React Aria Components

components.name: Combobox

id.description: Element id. Auto-derived from `name` (or the inherited `<FormField>` name) if omitted — needed for `<FormField>`'s `<label htmlFor>` to associate with this control.

name.description: Field name. Auto-inherited from parent `<FormField>` if omitted.

ariaLabel.description:
Accessible name announced by screen readers. Only needed when this
`Combobox` isn't inside a `<FormField label="...">` -- the `<label
htmlFor>` that renders provides the accessible name already in that
case, the same way it does for `Input`/`Select`/`Slider`.

options.description:
Client-side option list, filtered locally by substring match against
`label`. Omit when using `onSearch` for server-driven results instead.

onSearch.description:
Async search — called (debounced by `searchDebounceMs`) with the
current query whenever it changes. Takes over from `options` entirely
when provided; results replace the listbox contents once resolved.

multiple.description:
Allows selecting more than one option, rendered as removable chips.
Changes the shape of `value`/`defaultValue`/`onChange` from `string` to
`string[]`.

value.description: Controlled selected value — a string, or a string array when `multiple` is true.

defaultValue.description: Initial selected value (uncontrolled) — same shape as `value`.

onChange.description: Change handler. Receives the new value in the same shape as `value`.

allowCustomValue.description:
When true, text that doesn't match any option is committed as a
freeform value (or chip, when `multiple`) instead of being discarded.

disabled.description: If true, the combobox is non-interactive.

noResultsMessage.description: Message shown when no options match.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for input padding and item density. Only applies at the default `size="md"` — see `<Input>`'s own `size` doc for why.

size.description: Control size, standardized with `<Button>` and every other sized control so instances line up in a `<UIGroup>` row.

components.description: Filterable text input with a listbox, supporting client-side or async search and single/multi selection, bound to Form context

components.name: DatePicker

name.description: Field name. Auto-inherited from parent `<FormField>` if omitted.

value.description:
Controlled value, as an `@internationalized/date` `CalendarDate` --
never a raw JS `Date` at this boundary. Convert to/from a plain `Date`
at your own call site if your backend needs one.

onChange.description: Change handler. Receives the newly selected date, or `null` if cleared.

isDisabled.description: If true, the field is non-interactive.

locale.description:
BCP 47 locale tag. Fixed, not browser-auto-detected -- see
`<TimeField>`'s own doc for why an explicit default (not just a
provider's presence) is what actually prevents an SSR hydration
mismatch.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for the calendar popover's grid cell size.

size.description: Control size, standardized with `<Button>` and every other sized control so instances line up in a `<UIGroup>` row.

components.description: Date field + calendar popover, hosted in `<Popup>` (not React Aria's own popover), built on React Aria Components

components.name: FileUpload

name.description: Field name. Auto-inherited from parent `<FormField>` if omitted.

multiple.description: Allow selecting/dropping more than one file at once.

maxSizeBytes.description: Reject files larger than this, shown as a per-file error instead of starting an upload.

maxFiles.description: Cap on total accepted files. Extras dropped/selected past this are rejected.

disabled.description: If true, the dropzone is non-interactive.

onUpload.description:
Upload transport — toolcrib has no opinion on the backend protocol, so
this is entirely consumer-supplied. Called once per accepted file;
report progress via the given callback (0-100). Omit to just collect
files without uploading them (e.g. to upload them all together on a
later form submit instead).

onFilesChange.description: Fired whenever the accepted file list changes (add, remove, or status change).

overrides.description: Per-instance override for dropzone padding density. `overrides.density` wins over `size` below if both are set.

size.description: Control size, standardized with `<Button>` and every other sized control — maps onto the same `density` scale as `overrides.density` (`sm`→`'compact'`, `md`→`'normal'`, `lg`→`'spacious'`) and scales the dropzone's own label text.

components.description: Drag-and-drop file picker with per-file progress and image thumbnails, bound to Form context

components.name: Form
components.import: import { Form, FormField, FormError, Input, Select, Checkbox, Switch, Textarea, RadioGroup, Slider, SubmitButton, Button } from '#toolcrib'

schema.description: Zod schema for validation. Omit for unvalidated forms.

initialValues.description: Initial field values. Fields not listed default to empty string.

onSubmit.description:
Called with the schema's parsed output on successful submission — for
a schema using `z.coerce.number()`, `.transform()`, etc., this is the
transformed value (a real `number`), not the raw string every field
control itself always stores. Forms with no `schema` get the raw field
values as-is, since there's nothing to parse them into.

id.description: Form element id attribute. Also used as `formId` in event bus payloads.

components.description: Zod 4 schema-driven form. Controls bind via context — no register() or onChange boilerplate

components.name: Label

overrides.description: Per-instance override for the label's font weight and gap (when wrapping a control plus its own text).

components.description: Accessible label for a form control, associated via htmlFor or by wrapping it

components.name: Listbox

id.description: DOM id for the listbox container. Each option's own id is derived from this (`${id}-option-${index}`) — predictable so a caller can compute the active option's id for `aria-activedescendant` without Listbox needing to expose it separately.

activeIndex.description: Index of the currently keyboard-highlighted option, if any.

onSelect.description: Called when an option is chosen (via `mousedown`, so a fast pointer-down-then-drag selects correctly, matching native listbox feel — and before an input's own `blur` would otherwise run). Never called for a `disabled` option.

loading.description: Shows `loadingMessage` instead of the option list.

emptyMessage.description: Content shown when there are no options and not loading.

multiSelectable.description:
Whether more than one option can be selected at once — sets
`aria-multiselectable`. Every selected option gets a trailing
checkmark and a tinted background regardless of this flag; this only
controls whether more than one can carry that state simultaneously.

itemPadding.description: Per-option-row padding. Pass a caller's own themed CSS variable reference (e.g. Combobox passes `var(--ai-combobox-item-padding, ...)`) to keep density theme-consistent with the rest of that caller's own UI.

size.description: Control size, standardized with `<Button>` and every other sized control — drives the option row's font-size.

components.constraints: Purely presentational — owns no keyboard-navigation state; the caller drives `activeIndex` and reads back `${id}-option-${index}` for its own `aria-activedescendant`
components.description: Keyboard-navigable, controlled option list with no matching Radix primitive to build on — extracted from Combobox's own hand-built listbox, now usable standalone

components.name: Pagination

id.description: Unique identifier for `pagination:changed` event bus payloads. Auto-generated if omitted.

totalItems.description: Total number of items being paged across (not the number of pages).

page.description:
Controlled current page (1-indexed). Pass a value to drive paging from
parent state instead of letting `<Pagination>` manage it internally.
Omit for the common uncontrolled case; `defaultPage` seeds that
internal state instead.

onPageChange.description: Called whenever the page changes, whether controlled or uncontrolled.

size.description: Size of the page/nav buttons, passed straight through to the underlying `<Button>`s.

components.description: Page-number navigation control with Prev/Next, built on `<Button>` and shared page-index math with `<DataTable>`

components.name: RadioGroup

name.description: Field name. Auto-inherited from parent `<FormField>` if omitted.

onChange.description: Change handler. Receives the selected value string.

disabled.description: If true, all options are disabled.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for option spacing and radio dot size. `overrides.dotSize` wins over `size` below if both are set.

size.description: Control size — standardized with `<Button>` and every other sized control. Drives both the radio dot diameter (via the same scale as `overrides.dotSize`) and the option label's font size.

components.description: Single-select radio control bound to Form context, data-driven or compositional

components.name: Rating

name.description: Field name included in emitted `rating:changed` events.

onChange.description: Change handler. Receives the newly selected whole-number rating. Not called in `readOnly` mode.

icon.description: Icon rendered for a filled position.

readOnly.description:
Renders a non-interactive display instead of a collecting control —
for showing an existing (possibly fractional, e.g. an average) rating
rather than gathering one. `value` may be fractional in this mode; the
icon at a fractional position renders partially filled.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for icon size and gap.

components.description: Star rating control built on Radix RadioGroup, or a read-only fractional-fill display

components.name: Select

id.description: Element id. Auto-derived from `name` (or the inherited `<FormField>` name) if omitted — needed for `<FormField>`'s `<label htmlFor>` to associate with this control.

name.description: Field name. Auto-inherited from parent `<FormField>` if omitted.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text when no value is selected.

onChange.description: Change handler. Receives the selected value string.

disabled.description: If true, the select is non-interactive.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for trigger padding and item density. Only applies at the default `size="md"` — see `<Input>`'s own `size` doc for why.

size.description: Control size, standardized with `<Button>` and every other sized control so instances line up in a `<UIGroup>` row.

components.description: Dropdown select control bound to Form context, built on Radix Select

components.name: Slider

id.description: Element id. Auto-derived from `name` (or the inherited `<FormField>` name) if omitted — needed for `<FormField>`'s `<label htmlFor>` to associate with this control.

name.description: Field name. Auto-inherited from parent `<FormField>` if omitted. Used in event bus payloads.

onChange.description: Change handler. Receives the new numeric value.

disabled.description: If true, the slider is non-interactive.

commitOnRelease.description:
If true, `onChange`/`slider:changed` only fire once, when the drag
ends (or on a discrete keyboard step) — not continuously on every
tick while dragging. The thumb still tracks the pointer smoothly
either way (an internal buffer drives its visual position); this only
changes when the *consumer* is notified. Opt-in, not the default —
live per-tick updates are the right choice for most sliders (e.g. a
real-time value preview), including most of the Theme Designer's own
(color/timing values, which don't feed back into layout). It matters
for a specific narrower case: a slider whose value feeds back into
the page's own layout — the Theme Designer's Master Font Size above
all, since every `rem` value in the whole UI derives from it —  where
recalculating on every tick can resize or reposition the very slider
being dragged out from under the pointer mid-gesture, not just waste
a render. Deferring to release keeps the drag itself trackable
regardless of what the eventual committed value ends up changing.

ariaLabel.description:
Accessible name announced by screen readers. Only needed when this
`Slider` isn't inside a `<FormField label="...">` — the `<label
htmlFor>` that renders provides the accessible name already in that
case, the same way it does for `Input`/`Select`/`Combobox`.

overrides.description: Per-instance overrides for track height and thumb size.

components.description: Range input control built on Radix Slider

components.name: ThemeEditor

themeManagement.description:
Controls which Save & Load Themes commands appear in the header
toolbar. Omit (or `true`) for everything enabled — the default. Pass
`false` to hide the whole toolbar, or an options object to lock out
specific commands individually — e.g. an app author shipping a fixed
bundled theme (via `<ThemeProvider initialParameters={...}>`) who
doesn't want end users overriding it with an imported file, or
persisting their own local variant that outlives an intentional reset.
Ignored when `themeManagementSlot` is given — see that prop.

themeManagementSlot.description:
Replaces the entire built-in Save & Load Themes toolbar (presets,
save/load library, export/import) with your own UI, in the same
header position — for an app that wants different theme-selection/
persistence UX than the bundled one (e.g. a picker styled to match a
marketing site, or backed by the app's own account system instead of
`localStorage`). `themeManagement` is ignored while this is set: you
own this area completely, all-or-nothing, rather than mixing built-in
and custom pieces.

Nothing is threaded through as a render prop — every piece the
built-in toolbar itself is built from is already public API your own
slot component can call directly: `presetThemes` (`theme/
presetThemes.ts`) for the bundled swatches, `useTheme()` plus
`captureThemeSnapshot`/`applyThemeSnapshot` (`theme/
themePersistence.ts`) to read/write the live theme, and `theme/
themeLibrary.ts`/`theme/themeFileTransfer.ts` for the same
localStorage save/load and file export/import the default toolbar
uses.

components.description:
Real-time HSV theme editor content — no overlay chrome of its own;
host it inside a `<Drawer>` (or `<Modal>`/`<Popup>`) of your choosing.

components.name: TimeField

name.description: Field name. Auto-inherited from parent `<FormField>` if omitted.

value.description:
Controlled value, as an `@internationalized/date` `Time` -- never a raw
JS `Date` at this boundary (timezone/DST correctness is exactly what
that type exists to guarantee). Convert to/from a plain `Date` at your
own call site if your backend needs one.

onChange.description: Change handler. Receives the new `Time`, or `null` if cleared.

hourCycle.description: 12-hour vs. 24-hour display. Defaults to the active locale's own convention.

isDisabled.description: If true, the field is non-interactive.

locale.description:
BCP 47 locale tag controlling segment order and hour-cycle default.
Fixed, not browser-auto-detected -- an explicit default is what
prevents an SSR hydration mismatch (server and client disagreeing),
not the presence of a provider by itself.

size.description: Control size, standardized with `<Button>` and every other sized control so instances line up in a `<UIGroup>` row.

components.description: Segmented time input (hour/minute/second, individually keyboard-editable) built on React Aria Components

components.name: Toggle

name.description: Included in the emitted `toggle:changed` event payload.

onPressedChange.description: Change handler. Receives the new pressed state.

disabled.description: If true, the toggle is non-interactive.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for padding density. Shared with `<ToggleGroup>`. Only applies at the default `size="md"` — see `<Input>`'s own `size` doc for why.

size.description: Control size, standardized with `<Button>` and every other sized control so instances line up in a `<UIGroup>` row.

components.description: Two-state pressed/unpressed button, standalone (see ToggleGroup for a connected set)

name.description: Included in the emitted `togglegroup:changed` event payload.

type.description: `'single'` allows zero or one selected option. `'multiple'` allows any combination.

value.description: Controlled selected value(s) — a string for `type="single"`, a string array for `type="multiple"`.

onChange.description: Change handler. Receives the new value in the same shape as `value`.

options.description: Data-driven options rendered as connected buttons.

disabled.description: If true, every option is disabled.

overrides.description: Per-instance override for padding density. Shared with `<Toggle>`. Only applies at the default `size="md"` — see `<Input>`'s own `size` doc for why.

size.description: Control size, standardized with `<Button>` and every other sized control so instances line up in a `<UIGroup>` row.

components.description: Connected button set for single or multiple selection, data-driven

label.description: Display text for the option, and the text any caller's own filtering matches against. Still rendered as-is when `render` is omitted.

value.description: Value submitted/emitted when this option is selected.

disabled.description: If true, the option is visible but not selectable.

render.description: Custom content for this option, overriding the plain `label` text render. `label` still applies to any caller's own text-based filtering — this only changes what's visually shown.

label.description: Display label for this radio option.

value.description: Value submitted when this option is selected.

disabled.description: If true, this option is not selectable.

helperText.description: Additional help text below the option label.

value.description: Value submitted/emitted when this option is selected.

disabled.description: If true, the option is visible but not selectable.

value.description: Unique value for this option — appears in `value`/`togglegroup:changed`.
